resources.string: This narrow column lies closest to the midline along the spinous processes. The drawing shows its thoracic portion.
The middle column lies between spinalis and iliocostalis. In the thorax it attaches to vertebral projections and ribs.
The outermost column reaches the angles of the ribs, where the ribs curve away from the back toward the sides.
These bony projections mark the posterior midline of the vertebrae and orient the three paired columns on either side.
The pale lower tissue shows part of the broad attachment the erector spinae shares over the back of the sacrum and adjacent iliac crests.
